text:
maya: FYI running the replay harness on A100 shows a p95 tail delta vs synthetic of ~12%. This started after the infra image bump, suspect environment stack parity (driver/CUDA/container/kernel flags) affecting KV-cache warm path behavior.

jon: please paste repro command, image and driver details.

maya: repro below (shortened):
```
# bench run (replay)
bench-bot run --job replay --trace-id=kv-warm --image=redwood/serve:2026-03-09 --cuda=11.8 --driver=520.61.05 --base=ubuntu:22.04
replay-run --trace s3://bench/traces/kv-warm-2026-02 --concurrency=64 --duration=300s
```
Output snippet:
```
synthetic (same runtime): p95=118ms
replay (same runtime + trace): p95=132ms
~12% regression at p95, p99 spikes to ~410ms
```

lucas: interesting. When we moved drivers from 520->525 before, we saw kernel-launch serialization that hit prefix/KV warm paths. Can you collect ncu host-side traces + kernel timing?

maya: ran a light ncu capture; SM utilization looked fine but host-side stacks show longer gaps around KV hits. Host perf-top flame: 
```
__do_syscall_64 +0x12  [glibc-2.31]
pthread_mutex_lock  [libpthread]
io_submit (batching) wait
```
This suggests potential libc/container mismatch causing extra memcpy/syscall stalls.

jon: yep, we've hit similar: mismatched glibc + kernel headers change rseq/fast-path memcpy behavior and we see tiny host stalls that cascade into worse kernel selection / smaller grids. Also double-check container's libc and host rseq/unistd semantics.

bench-bot: replay job 1852114000 finished: avg 1185 req/s, errors=7, p50=58ms p95=132ms p99=410ms

maya: I compared ubuntu:20.04+driver520 vs ubuntu:22.04+driver520.61.05: small delta. Big delta only when both driver and base image changed together.

lucas: propose a triage matrix: GPUs [A100-40G, A100-80G, V100], drivers [520.x, 525.x, 530.x], CUDA [11.7,11.8,12.0], base images [ubuntu:20.04, ubuntu:22.04], kernel flags (swapaccount=0, rseq enabled), libc versions. Run synth vs replay with identical runtime image.

tara: I'll template this in infra. My plan: for each matrix cell run 3 short replays and compare p95 delta vs synthetic baseline. Gate if median delta > +3% p95. I'll wire job templates and result UIs.

samir: add a focused microtrace: KV-cache warmup that stresses prefix holds + random access to force evictions. That will amplify serialization. Also make a minimal local replay (replay-mini) so devs can repro without prod traces.

jon: request one more metric: capture cuda kernel launch latency distribution and kernel grid sizes at runtime. ncu host-sync traces are helpful for that. Also instrument runtime to emit KV-cache hit/miss counters and per-request tags so we can correlate high-latency requests to cache state.

maya: will add KV counters and a small perf wrapper that records: per-request KV-hit, kernel launch timestamp, chosen kernel id, and batching decision. We'll push a replay-mini and perf script to eng-runtime/tools/replay-mini.

lucas: earlier errant behavior looked like kernel selection picking smaller grid kernels under certain driver combos. We should also log kernel-selector inputs (seq len, batch, kv-hit-rate) so we can reproduce selector decisions offline.

maya: ops note: when driver >=525 we observed more small-grid kernel launches on A100, increasing serialization for short-token requests. Potential mitigations: pin driver in release, add CI matrix gating for replay vs synth parity, and add soft-fallback to alternate kernel if launch latency above threshold.

tara: created infra ticket INFRA-1723 and started MR with job templates and matrix harness: https://git.redwood/infra/infra/-/merge_requests/123 (PR includes test job YAML and result collector).

maya: I'll open two PRs: 1) replay-mini + small trace, 2) runtime metrics (KV counters + kernel-selector debug logs). Samir, want to pair on CI gating?

samir: yep, ping me. I'll add the gating step and the failure threshold logic.

jon: please also collect a small set of ncu captures (host-sync) for representative cells and attach to the infra ticket so we can analyze kernel launch latency distributions.

maya: will do. Quick summary of next actions: 
- run matrix across GPU/driver/CUDA/base-image/kernel flags (tara infra)
- add KV-cache microtrace and replay-mini for local repro (maya/samir)
- instrument runtime with KV hit/miss + kernel-selector inputs (maya)
- capture ncu host-sync traces for suspect cells (lucas/jon)
- gate matrix in CI and fail on p95 delta > +3% (samir/tara)

jon: thanks. please post short run results to INFRA-1723 so we can prioritize mitigations. :thumbsup:
